0x498c90.en: In Dokapon Kingdom,|gold is power.//The more gold you|gather, the greater|your power.//And the vault in this|castle also holds a|strange power.//The Goddess gave it to|my ancestors, saying,|'Cherish your gold.'//It is called the {{HL:0xb002}}World|Peace Bank{{HL:0xb008}}!//I speak no lies!//As long as the bank is|full of gold, world|peace is guaranteed!//

0x499210.en: I am counting on you,|heroes! Beat {{HL:0xb001}}Makonde{{HL:0xb008}}|quickly!//{{HL:0xb002}}Return the gold to the|World Peace Bank!{{HL:0xb008}}//Filling the vault is a|given, but amass cash,|rule many villages...//Gather assets any way|you can!//In this kingdom, those|with gold are the most|honored!//The legendary Dokapon|Hero will be whoever|has the most gold!//

0x4996d0.en: Oh, so he was such a|good person?//

0x499700.en: {{HL:0xb001}}Sanzou{{HL:0xb008}} got by on the|little thanks people|gave him, yes.//By the way, Asia folk|are all stingy, yes.//One day, a village|brat ate {{HL:0xb001}}Sanzou{{HL:0xb008}}'s|precious dumplings!//

0x499810.en: Worse, the brat even|kicked {{HL:0xb001}}Sanzou{{HL:0xb008}}, then|ran away...//Anyone would thrash|him, not just {{HL:0xb001}}Sanzou{{HL:0xb008}},|yes.//

0x4998e0.en: Then {{HL:0xb001}}Sanzou{{HL:0xb008}} seemed to|reach the limit of his|patience, yes.//Blind with rage, he|lost himself, yes...//

0x499950.en: He now uses his feng|shui power only for|himself, not us, yes.//He works the {{HL:0xb002}}dragon|veins{{HL:0xb008}} that rule money|to hoard Asia's gold.//Thanks to him, no gold|comes to us now, yes!//{{HL:0xb001}}Sanzou{{HL:0xb008}} eats the best|food daily, and pretty|ladies surround him!//I'm so jealous, yes...|That old lecher...//

0x499c00.en: [spk 0x3af8]Everyone has high|hopes for you, hero!//Let us make a big,|flashy debut now!//

0x499c60.en: The ruler of the Asia|Area is a wandering|monk, {{HL:0xb001}}Sanzou{{HL:0xb008}}, y'know.//When he first came, he|was a very good monk,|y'know.//He used feng shui to|solve the villagers'|troubles for free.//Worries of the future,|love, and debt. All|kinds of them!//

0x499f80.en: Then {{HL:0xb001}}Sanzou{{HL:0xb008}} hit the|limit of his patience,|y'know.//Blinded by rage, he|lost himself...//

0x49a000.en: He started using his|feng shui power only|for himself, not us.//He works the {{HL:0xb002}}dragon|veins{{HL:0xb008}} that rule money|to hoard Asia's gold.//Now no gold comes our|way at all, I tell ya!//{{HL:0xb001}}Sanzou{{HL:0xb008}} now eats the|best food daily and|keeps pretty ladies!//I'm green with envy...|That old lecher...//

0x49a400.en: [spk 0x3836]Chaaant!//[spk 0x3831]How dare you disturb|the dragon veins!//Now no gold will flow|to me, indeed!//

0x49a4c0.en: All this time I have|endured, and served|the villagers, indeed.//Yet all the thanks|they give is a mere|sparrow's tear.//Not one of them is|grateful, indeed!//I no longer care! I|will live in luxury,|indeed!//

0x49a8c0.en: ...I grew weary of|everyone's requests,|indeed.//Playing Cupid for|lovers, predicting|lottery numbers...//Even requests to Santa|for presents, at the|very end...//I have been enduring|it all just to live,|indeed.//Yet everyone thinks|only of themselves,|indeed.//Then, at that moment,|a suspicious voice|reached my ears...//It said to forget the|villagers and just|have fun...//I obeyed it, worked|the dragon veins, and|hoarded gold...//

0x49b370.en: It seems the girl was|not human, though...//The problem is what|came after~//His regret was so deep|that he could not rest|in peace~//As a spirit, he took|over a suit of armor|and lingered here~//To get revenge on her,|he began training to|grow stronger~//

0x49b520.en: Yes~|Strange as it is,|it seems so~//After brutal training,|{{HL:0xb001}}Red Brikin{{HL:0xb008}} became|many times stronger~//

0x49c230.en: Ahh... I want to see|her!//I was wrong!|What I feel for her|was never hatred!//This is...//Yes, love!//L-O-V-E, love!//Losing to her made me|fall for her even|harder!//

0x49c380.en: [spk 0x3842]Thank you, Sir Hero!//[spk 0x3843]You showed me true|strength, and I have|awoken!//I will go live in the|mountains and retrain|from scratch!//And someday I will be|a swordsman worthy of|that girl's love!//When that day comes,|cross swords with me|again!//[spk 0x3844]Farewell!//

0x49c930.en: The chief of the|Snowlander clan,|{{HL:0xb001}}Michieri{{HL:0xb008}}.//The Snowlanders have|lived in the snowy|peaks since long ago.//We used to get along|just fine.//I've heard some fella|in another village|even married one.//Dunno the details,|but the kids must be|pretty darn ugly.//

0x49ca80.en: Well, that's another|story.//Lately, savage snows|have left the mountain|bare of all life.//That's when they|started coming to raid|our village for food.//

0x49cc20.en: [spk 0x3b08]Got it!//To draw {{HL:0xb001}}Michieri{{HL:0xb008}} out,|first {{HL:0xb002}}develop{{HL:0xb008}} villages|into towns and cities!//Let's work hard to|develop the villages,|Hero!//

0x49ce90.en: Nooo, nooo. It's all|mine!//I'm gonna live every|day with a full belly!//

0x49d8d0.en: The chief was troubled|that he could not|marry.//He is no longer young,|but perhaps his looks|are too fearsome.//That was his one and|only worry.//But even he fell in|love.//The girl he fell for|was the fairest in the|village,//with a figure to|match.//

0x49da20.en: The chief courted her|fiercely, hoping to|win her heart.//Perhaps she was too|scared to refuse...//Somehow, they even|went on a date.//But on their second|date...//the very day he meant|to propose...//

0x49dc50.en: [spk 0x39b1]Hero, the villagers|are suffering.//Will you not defeat|the chief and bring|him to his senses?//

0x49dcf0.en: Free every village in|the North America|Area,//and the chief will|surely not sit idle.//For love and romance,|which he hates most,//will return to the|villages.//

0x49de20.en: [spk 0x39b8]Oh, bless me, bless|me! To think I'd meet|the legendary Hero!//Please sign something|for me as a keepsake.//It'll be our family|heirloom!//Now, where's a card, a|card...//

0x49dec0.en: [spk 0x3b11]That can wait!//Tell us about the boss|ruling the North|America Area!//

0x49e080.en: Truth is, the chief|was troubled that he|couldn't get married.//He's getting on in|years, but his looks|are scary, you see.//That was the chief's|one and only worry.//But even a guy with no|luck with women falls|in love.//The girl he fell for|was, rashly enough,//the fairest in the|village.//

0x49e1c0.en: The chief courted her|hard, trying to win|her heart.//Maybe she was too|scared to refuse him,|but they did date.//But then came their|second date.//It was the very day he|meant to propose.//

0x49e3d0.en: Hero, the villagers|are suffering.//Please, defeat the|chief and bring him to|his senses.//

0x49e470.en: {{HL:0xb002}}Liberate every village{{HL:0xb008}}|in the North America|Area,//and the chief won't|sit still.//After all, the love|and romance he hates|so much//will come back to|them!//

0x49e840.en: [spk 0x3b13]It's because you say|such things that|no girl likes you!//Just because you can't|get a date, don't ruin|it for happy couples!//

0x49ec40.en: ...A voice... I heard|a voice.//It said being unloved|isn't my fault. The|world is to blame.//Do away with|Valentine's Day and|Christmas, it said...//Led by that voice, I|came to see couples as|my sworn enemies...//

0x49ed30.en: That was {{HL:0xb001}}Makonde{{HL:0xb008}}!//He preyed on the heart|of a lonely guy!//A lonely guy's heart|is made of glass!//

0x49f300.en: [spk 0x3b17]No, no! The Hero came|to save everyone!//...Do we really look|that much like crooks?//

0x49f460.en: The stone idol's name|is {{HL:0xb001}}Imahhen{{HL:0xb008}}.//{{HL:0xb001}}Imahhen{{HL:0xb008}} was enshrined|in a temple deep in|the jungle as a deity.//People revered its|majestic form, and|prayed to it daily.//Then a miracle befell|the idol.//Why, the idol gained|a will of its own!//

0x49f5d0.en: At first, people|rejoiced and welcomed|him, but...//The problem was, the|will {{HL:0xb001}}Imahhen{{HL:0xb008}} gained|was a child's.//{{HL:0xb001}}Imahhen{{HL:0xb008}}, the world's|biggest, deadliest|brat, did as he liked.//No one dared to scold|him. They were too|afraid...//The worshipers at the|temple dwindled one by|one, until none came.//

0x49fd20.en: I don't care!|Everyone left me|all alone!//I hate every last one|of them!//

0x4a0930.en: But lately, when the|wombat {{HL:0xb002}}Fafa{{HL:0xb008}} debuted,|all his fans left him.//Stripped of his fame,|{{HL:0xb001}}Unphook{{HL:0xb008}} became a|bitter, jaded koala.//Ever since, he's spent|every day in town on|booze and brawls...//Thanks to his rampage,|the town is like this!//Oh! Where has the cute|{{HL:0xb001}}Unphook{{HL:0xb008}} of old|gone!?//

0x4a0ff0.en: [spk 0x3886]Hey, you!!//How dare you punch|my cute face!//Dang it!|I'll retreat for now!|[spk 0x387e]You'll pay for this!//

0x4a16c0.en: [spk 0x3880]Shut uuup!//Anyone who won't admit|how cute I am, anyone|who steals my spot...//I won't forgive 'em!|I'll clobber the whole|lot of you!//[spk 0x3886]Hey, you!//

0x4a27d0.en: Th-this isn't what|you promised...//In exchange for gold,|you would grant me|infinite dark power...//You said you'd give me|the power to rule the|world...//Wh-why...|{{HL:0xb001}}Rydeen{{HL:0xb008}}... my...|lord...//

0x4a2bf0.en: [spk 0x3897]Then go... I am counting|on you, heroes!//

0x4a3660.en: [spk 0x3b3b]This should let us|meet the {{HL:0xb001}}evil god{{HL:0xb008}}!//Hero, quick, set the|{{HL:0xb002}}stone tablet{{HL:0xb008}} in place!|My heart is pounding!//
